patch_description: The force-relaxation approach scores only 0.11, while the earlier smooth-softmax objective with L-BFGS-B scored 0.93. The best strategy is to return to that successful formulation and improve it with (1) beta annealing — first optimize a soft objective (beta=12) to escape poor basins, then re-polish with sharper beta=60 so the smooth min/max closely track the true discrete min/max; and (2) better initializers — the antipodal cube hint plus an icosahedron-derived seed (14 ≈ 12 icosahedron vertices + 2 antipodal extras) are strong, well-spread starting basins for points on a sphere. A modest number of restarts (with a couple of random seeds) keeps runtime near a few seconds while the annealed polish sharpens the final ratio above the previous 0.93 baseline.
